source.name: MLB.com press release (archived): Seattle Mariners expand relationship with Nintendo with team's first-ever jersey sleeve partnership
source.quote: The mark will debut on the Mariners jerseys on Opening Day, March 27 vs. the A's at T-Mobile Park.
source.note: Deal announced 2025-03-20 and debuted Opening Day 2025-03-27. Sports Business Journal (2025-03-20) reports 'a long-term pact worth seven figures annually' but gives no exact figure, so value stays null. Continues in 2026 per Blinkfire's 2026 list.

note: Jersey sleeve patch. Start corrected from 2026 to 2025, the season it debuted.
